quote: A U-turn may be made on any road where the turn can be made with safety, except as prohibited by this section [NRS-484B-403-2, NRS-484B-403-3] and by the provisions of NRS 484B.227, 484B.363 and 484B.407 [NRS-484B-227-1, NRS-484B-363-3, NRS-484B-407].

activation.condition: A motor vehicle driver makes a U-turn on a road.

obligation.description: A U-turn may be made where the whole turn can be made with safety, subject to cited prohibitions.

exceptions.source_clause: except as prohibited by this section
exceptions.description: NRS 484B.403(2) and (3); source each applicable alternative separately
Divided-highway crossing restriction and its alternatives require original road geometry and authority context
School-zone restriction and its time, child, sign or beacon context require original sources
Curve/crest and 500 ft both-direction visibility require original geometry and body-ray sources

timing.description: Assess safety through the whole U-turn and cited prohibition context at the maneuver.

judgment_calls_needed.note: No numeric legal cutoff is supplied; original whole-maneuver motion, gaps, braking, sight and context need independent review.
